<script>var sharedDocument = {};
var maximumItems = 3;
function loadDocument() {
  var elements = GetXFormFieldById("fd_json");
  if (elements && elements.length > 0) { sharedDocument = JSON.parse(elements[0].value); }
  for (var item = 0; item < maximumItems; item++) { readFlag(item); }
}
function readFlag(item) {
  var key = "item" + item + "_flag";
  if (sharedDocument[key] && Number(sharedDocument[key]) == 1) {} else {}
}</script><xform:editShow><script>AttachXFormValueChangeEventById("fd_choice",function(changed,element){sharedDocument.category=changed;});
